newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea sells dollars at 828.60 - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea sells dollars at 828.60 - dealers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) intervened again in the interbank market on Tuesday by selling dollars at the 828.60 won level, dealers said.
The won strengthened to 828.50 after the intervention but was expected to meet resistance as it approached 828.00.
The central bank began selling dollars in the morning session from 829.90 won to prevent the dollar from climbing over 830.00.
Without the intervention, the dollar was expected to soar due to heavy buying by importers, dealers said.
